description: Ten coarse model positions used only as soft attack-progress priors for M5 knowledge cross-attention. They are not an official MITRE ATT&CK ordering and must not be treated as a strict attack sequence.
rules: One knowledge item may map to multiple positions.
Progress is a soft prior, never a hard chronological constraint.
Real campaigns may revisit earlier tactics; M5 transition compatibility remains learnable.
Target-test ground truth must never be converted into knowledge records.
